metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the Welsh shore at half a voice, Fair Em, Hobbins, and Anne's letter.

yesterday: Burbage sat. Phillips bowed, and Nick heard that the putting-on is the part.
The letter of the last of August is in Hobbins's bag. It still says the back mends.
Anne wants the Michaelmas money when it falls. She had rather you ate.
The children have been quarrelling since Thursday over the girl at the window.
